facts.statement: A community party was held on the main level of the Snowhill playground, a block, launchpad, teleporter and elevator structure high in the hills of Snowhill, for dancing and hanging out.
facts.quote: We’re meeting on the main level of the playground for some dancing and hanging out.

facts.statement: The US and Latin America session was on Thursday, September 30, 2010 at 3pm Pacific Time on Server 1.
facts.quote: Thursday September 30th, 2010 3pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America) Server 1

facts.statement: The UK and Europe session was on Friday, October 1, 2010 at 9:00am Pacific Time (4:00pm GMT) on Server 1.
facts.quote: Friday October 1st, 2010 9:00am Pacific Time / 4:00pm GMT (UK and Europe) Server 1

article_summaries.title: Community Event: Snowhill Playground Party
article_summaries.summary: An official freerealms.com news post announcing a Community Event party on the Snowhill playground, held on Server 1 on 2010-09-30 (US/Latin America) and 2010-10-01 (UK/Europe). It also explains how players find Community events through the Game Guide calendar and its GO button. The post's exact publish date is not given (only 'posted 1 week, 6 days ago' relative to the capture).
